Author: G. S. Kulkarni
Bench: G. S. Kulkarni
2024:Bhc-As:23123-Db
 S.S.Kilaje 1
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
 Writ Petition No. 10050 Of 2016
 Shankar Bajirao Hargude and Ors. 
 Versus
 The State of Maharashtra and Ors.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Suresh M. Sabrad, Advocate for Petitioners.
Smt. M. S. Bane, Agp for the Respondent-State.

Coram : G. S. Kulkarni &
 Arun R. Pedneker,
Dated : 11 June, 2024 P.C. :
1.

Considering the fact that the issue as raised by the Petitioners primarily contending that the acquisition of the land in question has lapsed in view of the provisions of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and controversy now been settled in view of the decision of the Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court in the case of Indore Development Authority V/s. Manoharlal & Ors .1, Mr. Sabrad, learned Counsel for Petitioners seeks leave to withdraw the Petition.
2. Allowed to be withdrawn.
